'''Friends Forever''' (Korean: '''영원한 친구''' ''Yeongwonhan Chingu'') is the fourth ending theme for the Korean dub of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. It debuted in [[XY071]], replacing [[Hello! My Future!]]. It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, [[Roaring All-Stars]].

The full version of the song was used as the ending theme song for the 27th [[Pikachu short]] of the [[Pokémon animated series]], [[PK27]].

==Ending animation==
The song starts with Pikachu on stage dancing and playing with the Pokémon of {{Ash}}, {{an|Serena}}, {{an|Clemont}} and {{TRT}}.
